usageNotes: Returns the directory index of firewall sub-resources available for a specific LXC container, useful for discovering which firewall endpoints (rules, aliases, ipsets, options, log, refs) are accessible before making targeted calls. No special privileges are required — all authenticated users can query this index. Use this as a starting point when building firewall management workflows to confirm available sub-paths before operating on them.

examples.summary: List firewall sub-resources for LXC container 101 on node pve1

tips: The response is a navigation index only — it returns sub-resource names (e.g. 'rules', 'options', 'log', 'aliases', 'ipset', 'refs'), not actual firewall configuration data.
To retrieve or modify the container's actual firewall rules, follow up with the specific child endpoint such as get_nodes_node_lxc_vmid_firewall_rules or get_nodes_node_lxc_vmid_firewall_options.
This endpoint accepts API tokens (allowtoken: true), making it safe to use in automated scripts that discover firewall structure before reading or writing firewall config.
